description.en-US: The Pastoral Office (1883): Manning on the episcopate and the priesthood as states of perfection: its jurisdiction and perfection, the episcopate in Scripture and in three periods of tradition, the episcopate the state of perfection, the state of perfection in the priesthood, and a conclusion.
description.pt-BR: O Ofício Pastoral (1883): Manning sobre o epíscopado e o sacerdócio como estados de perfeição: sua jurisdição e perfeição, o epíscopado na Escritura e em três períodos da tradição, o epíscopado como estado de perfeição, o estado de perfeição no sacerdócio e uma conclusão.

sources.edition: The Pastoral Office (London: privately printed, 1883), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The preface and the six chapters; the contents and the index are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning died in 1892 and the edition is of 1883, so the text is public domain.

title.en-US: Chapter I. The Episcopate: its Jurisdiction and Perfection
Chapter II. The Nature of the Episcopate as Described in Scripture
Chapter III. The Doctrine of the Episcopate in Three Periods of Tradition
Chapter IV. The Episcopate the State of Perfection
Chapter V. The State of Perfection in the Priesthood
